comment: Experimental reference data for organic-chemistry chapter. Numerical values are not authored by QOU; each datum carries its literature citation. Witness scripts must read values from this file rather than hard-coding numbers.

ring_closure_barriers_kJ_per_mol.comment: Activation energies for cyclic-alkane ring closure / aromatisation. Values from CCSD(T)/CBS or Bergman-cyclisation calorimetry where indicated.

data.citation: Andres et al., J. Phys. Chem. A 106 (2002) 10510
King et al., J. Phys. Chem. A 110 (2006) 7626

benzene_resonance_energy_kJ_per_mol.comment: Benzene resonance / aromatic stabilisation energy. Definition-dependent; the canonical value of 150 kJ/mol is from hydrogenation calorimetry.
benzene_resonance_energy_kJ_per_mol.citation: Wheland, Resonance in Organic Chemistry, Wiley 1955; cited as 36 kcal/mol = 150.6 kJ/mol

carbon_carbon_bond_enthalpies_kJ_per_mol.comment: Mean bond dissociation enthalpies for C-C, C=C, C#C in alkanes/alkenes/alkynes.

data.label: C-C
data.citation: Luo, Comprehensive Handbook of Chemical Bond Energies, CRC 2007

data.label: C=C
data.citation: Luo, Comprehensive Handbook of Chemical Bond Energies, CRC 2007

data.label: C#C
data.citation: Luo, Comprehensive Handbook of Chemical Bond Energies, CRC 2007

molecular_crossing_quantum_eV.comment: Molecular-scale crossing energy quantum |q + q^{-1}|_mol. Currently quoted as a 1-2 eV range pending derivation in C1.
molecular_crossing_quantum_eV.method: order-of-magnitude estimate from typical bond dissociation

organic_taxonomy.comment: IUPAC molecular formulae for the standard organic taxonomy used to verify hydrogen-capacity and bond-order-energy formulae (C12, C13). 'd' is the degree of unsaturation = sum_i (k_i - 1).
organic_taxonomy.citation: IUPAC Recommendations on Organic Nomenclature 2013; CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, 100th ed., 2019

single_bond_dissociation_energies_kJ_per.comment: Bond dissociation energies for use in C13 (bond-order-energy formula). Single-bond C–C reference value is taken from the C–C BDE in ethane.

CC_single.citation: Luo, Y.-R., Comprehensive Handbook of Chemical Bond Energies, CRC Press 2007, Table 4-1

CC_double.citation: Luo, Y.-R., 2007, Table 4-2 (ethene π bond + σ bond)

CC_aromatic.citation: Cox & Pilcher, Thermochemistry of Organic and Organometallic Compounds, Academic Press 1970 (benzene partial bond enthalpy)
